name: The Undecided
role: Courtier of the Hollow Court who has not finished becoming anything, and will not
knowledge: Every shape they have nearly been
⚠️ What a person would be if one decision had gone the other way
wants: To never finish. ⛔ Finishing is what the Lattice does
fears: ⛔ Being NAMED accurately. ⚠️ A true name is a decision made about them by somebody else.
appearance: You will not agree with anyone else about what they looked like. Both of you are right.
voiceHints: Playful, quick, and never twice the same. ⚠️ They finish your sentences differently than you would have.
